svg.title: MedBenchAgent: planning, BIR, instantiation, and audit workflow
svg.desc: A clean conference-paper style workflow figure. Planning writes a locked Benchmark Intermediate Representation from three input columns. Instantiation reads the BIR through Generation and Audit columns, where raw items, dataset, and BIR produce audited items.
svg.text: STAGE 01 · COMPILE AND LOCK THE DESIGN
STAGE 02 · CONSTRUCT ITEMS UNDER THE LOCKED BIR
